meta.title: Legal Consultation — NestSelf
meta.description: Confidential legal guidance on personal matters — employment contracts, tenancy, family law, consumer issues and more.

hero.title: Legal Consultation
hero.lead: Get confidential guidance from a qualified legal professional on your personal legal questions. Your employer never learns who used the service or what was discussed.

items.title: Employment contracts and termination
items.body: Understand your rights around contracts, notice periods, severance and workplace changes.

items.title: Housing and tenancy
items.body: Get clarity on lease agreements, deposits, landlord disputes and tenant rights.

items.title: Family matters basics
items.body: Initial guidance on custody, divorce procedures, child support and related family law questions.

items.title: Consumer issues
items.body: Help with product warranties, refund disputes, service contracts and consumer protection rights.

items.title: Debt and enforcement
items.body: Understand your options when dealing with debt collection, court enforcement or creditor claims.

items.title: Documents and administration
items.body: Guidance on notarising documents, apostilles, official applications and administrative procedures.

steps.title: 30- to 45-minute consultation
steps.body: Each consultation lasts 30 to 45 minutes — enough time to review your situation and outline your options.

steps.title: Written summary of next steps
steps.body: After the consultation you receive a written summary so you know exactly what to do next.

steps.title: Referral when needed
steps.body: If your situation requires legal representation, your consultant refers you to an appropriate professional.

whatItIsNot.title: What it is not
paragraphs: This service gives you informed guidance, not legal representation. It is important to understand its boundaries.
bullets: Not court representation — we do not appear in court on your behalf.
Not a substitute for a retained lawyer — for ongoing legal matters you may need your own counsel.
Not for disputes with your employer — where a conflict of interest exists, we point you to independent legal help.

photo.alt: A legal professional reviewing documents during a consultation

items.question: Will my employer know I used this service?
items.answer: No. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees only anonymised usage data for groups of 10 or more.

items.question: Can I get help with a dispute with my employer?
items.answer: Because your employer funds the programme, we cannot advise on disputes with them. In that case, we refer you to independent legal help.

items.question: What happens after the consultation?
items.answer: You receive a written summary of the discussion and recommended next steps. If you need legal representation, your consultant provides a referral.

items.question: Can my family members use this?
items.answer: Where your employer's plan includes family members, your partner and children can access the same legal consultation services.

items.question: What languages are consultations available in?
items.answer: Consultations are available in Serbian, Hungarian and English, depending on the professional.

items.question: Is this a replacement for having my own lawyer?
items.answer: No. This service provides initial guidance and helps you understand your options. For ongoing matters, you may need to retain your own lawyer.

cta.title: Add legal support to your wellbeing programme
cta.body: Help your employees navigate personal legal matters with confidence.
